Space can also be reserved for private events, either large or small, in private dining rooms. Cabarets are performed monthly on Fridays.

name: Da Andrea - Chelsea
summary: Experience the beauty of authentic Italian dining with a menu that specializes in the art of homemade pasta, traditional Italian dishes, delicious risottos, and more.
address: 160 8th Avenue, New York, New York 10011, United States
summary2: Da Andrea is a neighborhood Italian ristorante located in Chelsea in Manhattan. Experience the beauty of authentic Italian dining with a menu that specializes in the art of homemade pasta, traditional Italian dishes, delicious risottos, and more. Each dish is meticulously prepared with fresh, locally sourced ingredients and an abundance of experience. Dining is a shared experience and every detail matters. Whether you’re in the mood for a glass of wine or a full four-course meal, Da Andrea takes patrons on a delectable journey in a warm and inviting ambiance.

name: Sushi Lab Rooftop
summary: Sushi Lab Rooftop is a New York City–born innovative concept with unique creations based on traditional sushi.
address: 130 West 47th Street, New York, New York 10036, United States
summary2: Set atop Sanctuary Hotel New York, Sushi Lab Rooftop is a New York City–born innovative concept with unique creations based on traditional sushi. Specializing in omakase, sashimi, nigiri and other Japanese delights, Sushi Lab provides a dining experience to be remembered.

name: Chela
summary: This Park Slope spot whips up inventive, beautifully plated cuisine leaning heavily on traditional South American flavors.
address: 408 Grand Army Plaza, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Helmed by chef-owner (and cocktail enthusiast) Ronny Jaramillo, this Park Slope spot whips up inventive, beautifully plated cuisine leaning heavily on traditional South American flavors. Stop by for brunch to try their bloody Maria, or snack on Mexican poutine during happy hour.

name: Morton's The Steakhouse—World Trade Center
summary: Nestled in the heart of Lower Manhattan, located in the World Trade Center, Morton's The Steakhouse is a true blend of classic cuisine and contemporary style.
address: 136 Washington Street, New York, New York 10006, United States
summary2: Nestled in Lower Manhattan near the World Trade Center, Morton's The Steakhouse is a true blend of classic cuisine and contemporary style. Morton's features USDA prime aged beef, world-class wines, cocktails from martinis to Manhattans, succulent seafood, timeless steakhouse sides and decadent desserts. The restaurant is located just steps from the 9/11 Memorial, while the Statue of Liberty, Ellis Island, Wall Street and City Hall are all nearby.

name: Nick + Stef's Steakhouse
summary: Nick + Stef's is a masterful blend of ultra-stylish contemporary design and time-honored culinary artistry.
address: 9 Pennsylvania Plaza, New York, New York 10001, United States
summary2: Nick + Stef's is a masterful blend of ultra-stylish contemporary design and time-honored culinary artistry. Directly adjacent to Madison Square Garden on West 33rd Street, it's the place to go before and after concerts and games for succulent steaks, fresh seafood and signature side dishes.

name: The Russian Tea Room
summary: This opulent restaurant has been a treasured destination since 1927, serving continental classics in a soaring setting.
address: 150 West 57th Street, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: The Russian Tea Room is a treasured, globally-renowned cultural institution and an enchanting, magical place where people of all ages and backgrounds have been having unforgettable dining and celebratory experiences for more than 90 years. Simultaneously a sanctuary of refinement, fine cuisine and elegance, and a bastion of delicious, decadent, glamorous fun, The Russian Tea Room provides a luxurious, world-class experience that is universally accessible and provides unparalleled quality and exceptional value.

name: Soogil
summary: Chef Soogil Lim's refined French technique infuses with his Korean heritage for exceptional dishes that stay true to both.
address: 108 East 4th Street, New York, New York 10003, United States
summary2: After working for seven years under chef Daniel Boulud (three as sous chef) and honing his French technique, chef Soogil Lim became executive chef at Hanjan, where he ran the kitchen for four years. With the opening of his own restaurant, Soogil blends the two backgrounds he knows best: French and Korean. His refined French technique infuses with his Korean heritage for exceptional dishes that stay true to both.

name: Dowling’s at The Carlyle
summary: Dowling’s at The Carlyle's menu features chef Moosah Reaume’s interpretations of timeless New York favorites and throwback dishes from another era, with an emphasis on tableside preparations.
address: 35 East 76th Street, New York, New York 10021, United States
summary2: Dowling’s at The Carlyle, the latest addition to The Carlyle family, is named after Robert Whittle Dowling, owner of the hotel in the 1940s. The menu features chef Moosah Reaume’s interpretations of timeless New York favorites and throwback dishes from another era, with an emphasis on tableside preparations. Dowling’s at The Carlyle is open daily for breakfast, lunch and dinner, and offers weekend brunch.

name: Sei Less
summary: Curiously nestled behind an enigmatic mural in Midtown, behind a blink-and-you’ll-miss-it door stands Sei Less, an Asian fusion restaurant with an exclusive flair.
address: 156 West 38th Street, New York, New York 10018, United States
summary2: Curiously nestled behind an enigmatic mural in Midtown, behind a blink-and-you’ll-miss-it door stands Sei Less, an Asian fusion restaurant with an exclusive flair. Set near the Garment District and Madison Square Garden, it's the spot to stop at before or after an event. Sei Less is a hotspot for a romantic date night in a dark corner or a place for a larger party. From album release parties to business meetings, to private events, Sei Less does it all with an air of elegant exclusivity. Dress code is Casual Elegant and entry is subject to doorman discretion.

name: Steak Frites Bistro
summary: Chef/owner Adam Schop brings classic French fare, in an environment familiar to popular bistros found on the side streets of Paris, to Hell’s Kitchen.
address: 496 Ninth Avenue, New York, New York 10018, United States
summary2: At his Steak Frites Bistro, chef/owner Adam Schop brings classic French fare, in an environment familiar to popular bistros found on the side streets of Paris, to Hell’s Kitchen. His French cuisine is presented through a New York lens, marrying the two cultures and adding another level of familiarity. Steak Frites Bistro’s dinner menu is concise and provides options for every diner—from those looking to indulge in a multicourse French meal to those on the hunt for a quick, delicious bite—including French, Francophiles, and neighborhood clientele.

name: Sushi Sen-Nin
summary: Delicious and scrumptious, Sushi Sen-nin’s selection of fish and daily catch are for both the eyes and the mouth to feast on.
address: 30 East 33rd Street, New York, New York 10016, United States
summary2: Delicious and scrumptious, Sushi Sen-nin’s selection of fish and daily catch are for both the eyes and the mouth to feast on. Chef Matsu, using his extensive knowledge of Japanese cuisine, prepares traditional Japanese delicacies and dishes with his own flair and ingenuity. The menu is extensive, and while the prices can make it a splurge, the straight-from-the-sea taste is well worth it.

name: Kings of Kobe
summary: The towering American Wagyu burger creations and mouth-melting American Wagyu steaks—and the frenzy of sides—speak to the Kings of Kobe core: unadulterated, delicious fun.
address: 650 West 42nd Street, New York, New York 10036, United States
summary2: Known for its wildly creative, premium American Wagyu burgers, Kings of Kobe takes everything up a notch with bold flavors, indulgent ingredients, and a touch of irreverence. But the story doesn’t stop at the bun: their American Wagyu steaks bring the same swagger, seared hot and paired with house-made sauces that hit hard. For those looking for the ultimate indulgence, they offer a selection of Japanese A5 Wagyu—rich, rare, and priced like nowhere else in NYC. Kings of Kobe is open seven days a week for lunch and dinner, with a daily Happy Hour, and an all-day bar dining menu, to deliver steakhouse-level firepower in a space that’s more fun than formal. Guests rave about the energy, friendly service, and inventive starters like giant mozzarella sticks, Wagyu “cinnamon buns,” and other sleeper hits that go way beyond beef. Whether you’re diving into cocktails at the bar or going all-in on Wagyu, the portions are big, the vibe is bigger, and the flavor is loud, proud, and unapologetically Wagyu.

name: Calle Dão - Bryant Park
summary: Calle Dão pays homage to Havana’s once-thriving El Barrio Chino (Chinatown), once the largest such community in Latin America.
address: 38 West 39th Street, New York, New York 10018, United States
summary2: Calle Dão pays homage to Havana’s once-thriving El Barrio Chino (Chinatown), once the largest such community in Latin America. As the Cuban and Chinese cultures mixed, a unique fusion of cuisine emerged. The cuisine, cocktails and décor of Calle Dão strive to transport guests back to El Barrio Chino when it was at the height of its existence. Calle Dão has created mouthwatering dishes that seamlessly blend Cuban staples with Asian flavors. The cocktails, created by Mixologist Joy Daniel, also meld the old world with the new using historic names for libations with modern ingredients.

name: Bourbon Steak New York
summary: Bourbon Steak is chef Michael Mina's love letter to the classic American steakhouse, serving the finest cuts of premium beef and seafood, as well as seasonal ingredients sourced from local farmers and purveyors.
address: 160 Central Park South, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Located in the iconic JW Marriott Essex House New York, Bourbon Steak is chef Michael Mina's love letter to the classic American steakhouse. Featuring the finest cuts of premium beef and seafood, as well as seasonal ingredients sourced from local farmers and purveyors, Bourbon Steak showcases creative, elevated takes on classic steakhouse fare enriched with global flavors, complemented by a world-class beverage program with extensive wine and spirits offerings.

name: Mission Ceviche - Union Square
summary: Mission Ceviche, from chef Jose Luis Chavez and partner Brice Mastroluca, has become synonymous with modern Peruvian cuisine, offering a diverse array of dishes crafted from the freshest ingredients.
address: 7 East 17th Street, New York, New York 10003, United States
summary2: Mission Ceviche was born in 2015 when chef Jose Luis Chavez and partner Brice Mastroluca outfitted a modest stall within Gansevoort Market to create an homage to the flavors of Peru. The initial success at Gansevoort Market spurred the establishment of a second fast-casual spot in Canal Street Market, and building on the momentum, the partners took Mission Ceviche to new heights with the opening of its first sit-down restaurant on the Upper East Side in 2019. The restaurant found immediate critical success after launching, earning a star from Pete Wells at the New York Times and a feature in the Michelin Guide. Mission Ceviche has become synonymous with modern Peruvian cuisine, offering a diverse array of dishes crafted from the freshest ingredients.

name: Sagaponack
summary: Sagaponack is a seafood restaurant specializing in chef-driven approachable quality.
address: 4 West 22nd Street, New York, New York 10010, United States
summary2: Located in Manhattan’s bustling Flatiron neighborhood, Sagaponack is a seafood restaurant specializing in chef-driven approachable quality. Helming the kitchen is chef Phil Choy, who developed shareable plates for an inviting experience, in addition to creating an approachable seafood menu for everyone.

name: Veerays
summary: Located in Manhattan's Midtown East, Veerays is NYC’s first Indian speakeasy restaurant, envisioned by Michelin-starred chef Hemant Mathur.
address: 213 East 45th Street, New York, New York 10017, United States
summary2: Veerays is NYC’s first Indian speakeasy restaurant, envisioned by Michelin-starred chef Hemant Mathur. Located in Manhattan's Midtown East, Veerays redefines Indian cuisine with a menu of innovative curries and grills. The intimate space captures the allure of the 1920s Prohibition era, serving signature cocktails inspired by the era, alongside a meticulously curated selection of wine, beer, and spirits. Reservations are recommended, but walk-ins are warmly welcomed. Veerays the ideal destination for an unforgettable culinary experience.

name: Rowland's Bar & Grill
summary: Rowland's Bar & Grill serves American gastropub cuisine in a comfortable, modern atmosphere on the lower level at Macy's Herald Square.
address: 151 West 34th Street, New York, New York 10001, United States
summary2: Rowland’s Bar & Grill serves American gastropub cuisine in a comfortable, modern atmosphere on the new One Below level at Macy’s Herald Square. Named for Rowland H. Macy, the storied founder of Macy’s, Rowland’s Bar & Grill builds upon his magnanimous character with intriguing bits of his life, quotes and favorite foods. Rowland’s is the perfect gathering place when shopping New York’s most famous store.

name: Limusina
summary: Limusina is a new Mexican restaurant by Quality Branded, inspired by New York City in the 1970s and ‘80s.
address: 441 Ninth Avenue, New York, New York 10001, United States
summary2: Limusina is a new Mexican restaurant by Quality Branded, inspired by New York City in the 1970s and ‘80s. In that era, nothing was more luxurious than a limousine. The restaurant space was once a taxi and limo depot, a parking garage where drivers would take their cars off-duty to be serviced, grab a bodega coffee and snacks, and loosen their ties before heading back uptown to pick up their clients. The restaurant mirrors that juxtaposition of glam and grit. Limusina has luxe, rich materials and custom fixtures next to raw, exposed concrete columns. Custom light fixtures are affixed to industrial, unfinished ceilings. The restaurant reflects the neighborhood it's in, on the cusp of the shiny, new Hudson Yards and the gritty lower Midtown. Menu favorites include fresh aguachile, queso fundido, long-bone short rib quesabirria, and churritos for dessert.

name: Bar Sprezzatura
summary: Bar Sprezzatura NYC is a coastal-inspired rooftop aperitivo bar and restaurant located atop the Kimpton Theta New York - Times Square hotel.
address: 251 West 48th Street, New York, New York 10036, United States
summary2: Bar Sprezzatura NYC is a coastal-inspired rooftop aperitivo bar and restaurant located atop the Kimpton Theta New York - Times Square hotel. Drawing inspiration from the effortless elegance of the Italian Riviera, it offers a bi-level setting with both indoor and outdoor seating, providing a vibrant atmosphere for guests to enjoy signature spritzes, unique martinis, and refined stuzzichini. Whether you’re looking for an aperitivo, pre-theater drinks, or an elegant dining experience, Bar Sprezzatura is your go-to gathering place.

name: The Wolfe
summary: The Wolfe is a sports bar and restaurant inspired by Tom Wolfe, the late novelist and long-time NYC resident.
address: 425 Amsterdam Avenue, New York, New York 10024, United States
summary2: The Wolfe is a sports bar and restaurant inspired by Tom Wolfe, the late novelist and long-time NYC resident, whose more well-known works include The Electric Kool-Aid Acid Test, The Right Stuff, and The Bonfire of the Vanities. The Wolfe aims to provide a classy place to enjoy food, sports and events. The decor and menu include nods to Wolfe, such as a cocktail called The Bonfire, a twist on an old fashioned with mezcal, reposado and smoked agave liquor. The menu runs from dry-rubbed chicken wings to mango Thai noodle to "Everything Crusted" ahi tuna.

name: Fish Cheeks
summary: Family-style Thai seafood and great cocktails in NoHo.
address: 55 Bond Street, New York, New York 10012, United States
summary2: Fish Cheeks has a cheeky design; its awning is layered like colorful fish scales, primary colors brighten the cafeteria-like dining room and overturned baskets serve as lampshades overhead. Brothers and co-chefs Chat and Ohm Suansilphong, whose parents owned a restaurant in Thailand, prepare Thai family-style dishes at varying levels of spiciness; standouts include coconut crab curry and steamed whole fish with aromatic Thai herbs. Non-seafood items like grilled pork cheeks with jeaw sauce and potent cocktails are also exemplary.

name: Chez Josephine
summary: This romantic, red-velvet dining room is ideal for late-night, post-show dining with its lively scene and reinterpretations of bistro benchmarks.
address: 414 West 42nd Street, New York, New York 10036, United States
summary2: Paris, 1930. Walk through the doors of Chez Josephine and you are transported to another country, another time. Named after the incomparable singer Josephine Baker, this romantic, red-velvet dining room is ideal for late-night, post-show dining with its lively scene and reinterpretations of bistro benchmarks. The jazz-age spirit of the place imbues every aspect of the experience.

name: Dinner Party
summary: The cuisine falls somewhere between French, Italian, and, as the chef loves to insist, “Californian”—reflecting the myriad possible directions of a set menu that changes every week.
address: 274 Hall Street, Brooklyn, New York 11205, United States
summary2: Dinner Party was founded in 2021 by six young women with no professional cooking experience and only half-hearted pretensions of sophistication. Most of them were strangers when they started, but they were lifelong friends by the end of the first month open. The restaurant aims to feel that way: like you’re dining among instant friends, laughing as much as you’re eating. The cuisine’s rustic and lovingly-made, balanced but never boring. It falls somewhere between French, Italian, and, as the chef loves to insist, “Californian”—reflecting the myriad possible directions of a set menu that changes every week.

name: Bocca Di Bacco—Hell's Kitchen
summary: Bocca Di Bacco—Hell's Kitchen, an Italian restaurant located near Columbus Circle and Central Park, is a favorite spot for celebrities, tourists and native New Yorkers alike.
address: 828 9th Avenue, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Bocca Di Bacco—Hell's Kitchen, an Italian restaurant located near Columbus Circle and Central Park, is a favorite spot for celebrities, tourists and native New Yorkers alike. Known for top-notch Italian cuisine, they also have an excellent wine selection that features 500 of the best vintages from renowned Italian wineries. Bocca Di Bacco—Hell's Kitchen serves delicious and creative Italian cuisine, which includes homemade pasta, meats and seafood.

name: Mae Mae Cafe & Plant Shop
summary: Mae Mae Cafe & Plant Shop is a plant-based cafe and bar in Mott Haven that is also a plant shop.
address: 2417 Third Avenue, Bronx, New York 10451, United States
summary2: Mae Mae Cafe & Plant Shop is a plant-based cafe and bar in Mott Haven that is also a plant shop. The stylish lunch cafe and wine bar serves eclectic vegan fare sourced from its own Upstate New York organic farm, alongside coffee, wine and creative cocktails. Their plant collection changes often based on the latest items in season, customer recommendations, and suggestions from their local nurseries.

name: Nusr-Et - Midtown
summary: Nusr-Et is an internationally acclaimed destination for luxury dining from Nusret "Salt Bae" Gökçeis, a Turkish butcher, chef, and restaurateur whose technique became an internet meme.
address: 60 West 53rd Street, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Nusr-Et is an internationally acclaimed destination for luxury dining from Nusret "Salt Bae" Gökçeis, a Turkish butcher, chef, and restaurateur whose technique for preparing and seasoning meat became an internet meme. Its globally praised, unique concept combines an innovative menu with impeccable service and great fun. The meat-focused menu includes not only a wide range of premium cuts of Wagyu beef, but several items (steak, rack of lamb, burger) coated in real 24k gold.

name: Dos Caminos Lexington
summary: Margaritas and Mexican cuisine meet serious south-of-the-border style at this boisterous, popular mega-eatery.
address: 480 Lexington Avenue, New York, New York 10017, United States
summary2: Margaritas and Mexican cuisine meet serious south-of-the-border style at this boisterous, popular mega-eatery. With more than 100 types of tequila, Dos Caminos easily attracts the after-work crowd for creative libations like the chile-infused Cosmos del Diablo and addictive appetizers such as fresh guacamole prepared table-side and plantain-stuffed empanadas. But its inventive renditions of traditional Latin cooking, including Black Angus skirt steak and coconut-strawberry tres leches cake, should lure folks to linger past cocktail hour.

name: Momoya - Upper West Side
summary: The beloved Japanese restaurant Momoya has added this new incarnation on Manhattan's Upper West Side.
address: 427 Amsterdam Avenue, New York, New York 10024, United States
summary2: The beloved Japanese restaurant Momoya has added this new incarnation on Manhattan's Upper West Side. Choose from kitchen entrées like teriyaki, Scottish salmon or grass-fed rib eye. Noodle dishes are served with wasabi seaweed tempura and oshinko. The extensive sushi menu features entrées such as the eight-piece sushi, tuna roll or the 15-piece sashimi. Beverages include an international wine list as well as specialty cocktails like the Gin Ray or the Momo splash created with peach sake, rose champagne and orange juice.

name: Fandi Mata
summary: Fandi Mata delivers a new take on artisinal, global cuisine inspired by the vast Mediterranean region, featuring classics with a contemporary touch.
address: 74 Bayard Street, Brooklyn, New York 11222, United States
summary2: Fandi Mata delivers a new take on artisinal, global cuisine inspired by the vast Mediterranean region, featuring classics with a contemporary touch. Chef Javier Vazquez Mariño incorporates eclectic, world-driven cuisine while offering an effortlessly familial hospitality experience that takes guests on a vibrant and whimsical voyage around the globe for an avant-garde culinary and mixology experience.

name: Empire Steak House - Midtown East
summary: Empire Steak House's location on the east side has two raised tiers of seating featuring wrap-around booths and a hand-painted dome.
address: 151 East 50th Street, New York, New York 10022, United States
summary2: Empire Steak House's location on the east side has two raised tiers of seating featuring wrap-around booths and a hand-painted dome. While Empire is acclaimed for steaks such as its famous dry-aged porterhouse for two, the rest of the menu is equally stellar, featuring a wide range of fresh seafood including 4- to 5-lb. lobsters. The 50th street location also offers specialty cuts like the Tomahawk ribeye, bone-in ribeye, Cajun bone-in ribeye, double cut rack of veal and an exclusive Emperors steak for two.

name: Crown Shy
summary: Find creative fine dining in a stunning art deco tower.
address: 70 Pine Street, New York, New York 10005, United States
summary2: Crown Shy is the first solo project from the late chef Jamal James Kent. The restaurant, which has one Michelin Star, is located at the base of a landmark art deco tower in Lower Manhattan’s Financial District at 70 Pine Street, its dining room modern and dramatic. Commence with pull-apart olive bread and spellbinding gruyère fritters followed by mafaldine with rock shrimp and chorizo. Other highlights of this creative menu include roasted short rib, crispy eggplant, sungold marinara, and mozzarella. Finish the night with the legendary sticky toffee pudding and green apple sorbet.

name: Burger & Lobster Bryant Park
summary: Burger & Lobster has been serving the finest of burgers and the freshest of lobsters since 2014.
address: 132 West 43rd Street, New York, New York 10036, United States
summary2: Burger & Lobster has been serving the best burgers and the freshest of lobsters since 2014. Their multilevel space in Times Square has soaring ceilings, unique art works and live lobster storage. Burger & Lobster offers lunch and dinner Monday through Sunday, plus brunch on the weekends, and extensive beverage offerings. Private dining space is also available.

name: La Grande Boucherie
summary: With a dazzling dining gallery, this one-of-a-kind brasserie is built in the tradition of the Belle Epoque, inspired by elegant and ornamental Art Nouveau style.
address: 145 West 53rd Street, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: With a dazzling dining gallery featuring 40-foot glass ceilings, this one-of-a-kind brasserie is built in the tradition of the Belle Époque, inspired by elegant and ornamental Art Nouveau style. The menu highlights timeless French classics, from hors d’œuvres and plats principaux to desserts crafted to embody true joie de vivre, alongside a diverse selection of prime steaks, an in-house dry-aged meat program, and premium A5 Japanese wagyu. In addition to the proprietary Boucherie Wine Collection and classic cocktails, La Grande Boucherie also features an inspired menu of absinthe-driven signature drinks.

name: Carne Mare
summary: Carne Mare is an Italian chophouse by chef Andrew Carmellini offering prime cuts of steaks, fine seafood and Italian specialties.
summary2: Carne Mare is an Italian chophouse by chef Andrew Carmellini offering prime cuts of steaks, fine seafood and Italian specialties.

name: DiWine
summary: DiWine is a wine bar and New American restaurant focused on natural biodynamic wines and hand-crafted cocktails in a relaxed atmosphere.
address: 41-15 31st Avenue, Astoria, New York 11103, United States
summary2: DiWine is a wine bar and New American restaurant focused on natural biodynamic wines and hand-crafted cocktails in a relaxed atmosphere. Founded in 2009, DiWine offers a romantic atmosphere with custom curtained booths, a hand carved wooden bar, and award-winning cocktails and artisan food.

name: STK Midtown
summary: Simply put, STK is not your daddy's steakhouse.
address: 1114 Sixth Avenue, New York, New York 10036, United States
summary2: Simply put, STK is not your daddy's steakhouse. The restaurant brings high-energy dining to Manhattan, breaking down the barriers of a normal steakhouse by losing the overly masculine vibe that has long been the trademark of the genre. Maintaining the quality of a traditional steakhouse and simultaneously reinventing the ambiance, clientele and atmosphere, STK introduces the sensibility of a flirty and feminine steakhouse to a young, sexy market. STK offers a bustling bar that builds on the energy of a DJ spinning tracks nightly. The restaurant layout and striking décor create an intimate, one-of-a-kind dining experience.

name: Mesiba
summary: Tel Aviv-inspired restaurant takes inspiration from Bar Lab Hospitality’s founding partner Elad Zvi’s childhood memories of the diverse flavors of Israel.
address: 353 Bedford Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11211, United States
summary2: Mesiba is a Tel Aviv-inspired restaurant in Williambsurg, Brooklyn. Meaning "party" in Hebrew, Mesiba takes inspiration from Bar Lab Hospitality’s founding partner Elad Zvi’s childhood memories of the diverse flavors of Israel, animated by the celebratory "breaking bread" culture of the Levant. Mesiba features contemporary Levantine cuisine by chef Eli Buli and innovative, vibrant cocktails in an eclectic and lively design-forward atmosphere.

name: Ophelia Lounge NYC
summary: Find old-school glamour and new-school cocktails at this rooftop bar.
address: 3 Mitchell Place, New York, New York 10017, United States
summary2: Set on the 26th-floor rooftop of the historic Beekman Tower, Ophelia takes inspiration from its art deco building, maintaining some of the original 1928 touches while adding velvet booths and a checkerboard floor. The cocktail menu matches the space in its mix of classics (martinis, old-fashioneds) and modern drinks, like Ophelia’s Ascension, which blends mezcal, Sri Lankan palm sugar, bitters and cedar smoke. Even a simple highball feels extra special in the space, whether enjoyed at the 24-foot pewter bar or on the outdoor terrace with 360-degree city views.

name: Riverpark
summary: Enjoy the seasonally inspired, seafood-forward, New American cuisine with some of the best waterfront views NYC has to offer.
address: 450 East 29th Street, New York, New York 10016, United States
summary2: Riverpark’s elegant space boasts floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of the East River, conveniently tucked away in a tranquil corner of Manhattan, and offers relaxed yet elevated dining and private events in the Kips Bay neighborhood. Enjoy the seasonally inspired, seafood-forward, New American cuisine paired with curated craft cocktails and an award-winning wine list. Riverpark is the perfect place for the after-work crowd to gather—unwind with some of the best waterfront views NYC has to offer.

name: Recette
summary: Recette is a lively French bistro in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, featuring tasty dishes and unique specials by executive chef Alan Vargas.
address: 103 Havemeyer Street, Brooklyn, New York 11211, United States
summary2: Recette is a lively French bistro in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, featuring tasty dishes and unique specials by executive chef Alan Vargas (The Consulate, Masa).

name: Crave Fishbar - Upper East Side
summary: This Upper East Side location serves creative seafood in an upscale neighborhood setting, complete with warm hospitality.
address: 1462 2nd Avenue, New York, New York 10075, United States
summary2: Crave Fishbar—NYC’s first 100% sustainable seafood restaurant—is home to the #Oystergram Happy Hour, one of NYC’s best oyster happy hour deals. This Upper East Side location serves creative seafood in an upscale neighborhood setting, complete with warm hospitality. Global flavors and innovative preparations highlight their sustainable seafood, heritage meats, and organic produce. The raw bar features a daily selection of East Coast and West Coast oysters, sometimes up to 20 varieties each night. For business dinners, special occasions, and dining out just-because, Crave serves a sustainable and memorable meal.

name: Le Jardinier
summary: This chic French restaurant in Midtown has a vegetable-forward menu.
address: 610 Lexington Avenue, New York, New York 10022, United States
summary2: Le Jardinier is a verdant, sophisticated restaurant at the base of a chic residential tower on the corner of Lexington Avenue and 53rd Street. Helming the kitchen is a Michelin-starred French chef, Alain Verzeroli. Verzeroli is a protégé of the late Joël Robuchon, who was originally slated to be the culinary force here. Look for beautiful vegetable compositions, Dover sole for two and lobster with smoked potatoes. Each meal starts with an “amuse-juice” (perhaps kale, pineapple and ginger), and all house-baked breads are gluten-free.

name: Audace
summary: Whether dining in the main room or celebrating on the private rooftop, guests discover an elevated Italian experience where passion, precision, and New York sophistication come together beautifully.
address: 365 Park Avenue South, New York, New York 10016, United States
summary2: Audace is where New York refinement meets the soul of Italy. Awarded by Gambero Rosso as one of the best Italian restaurants in NYC, and ranked the 37th-best pizzeria in the USA by the prestigious 50 Top Pizza, Audace celebrates Italian excellence at its highest level. Their celebrated Neapolitan-style crust—airy, delicate, and masterfully fermented—stands alongside an elegant menu that blends tradition with modern Italian craftsmanship. Inside, the atmosphere is intimate and upscale, with warm lighting, refined décor, and the unmistakable energy of NoMad. Service is meticulous and heartfelt, delivered with the elegance of fine dining and the warmth of true Italian hospitality. At Audace, every detail matters, from the first amuse-bouche to the last sip of wine. Whether dining in the main room or celebrating on the private rooftop, guests discover an elevated Italian experience where passion, precision, and New York sophistication come together beautifully.

name: Gitano NYC
summary: Bohemian, opulent, and glamorous, brining Gitano's signature tropical rustic elegance to the City with modern Mexican cuisine, signature mezcal cocktails, and an indoor-outdoor jungle experience.
summary2: Gitano NYC is Gitano's year-round flagship in the Unted States, a spectacular 14,000-square-foot waterfront restaurant, lounge, and club with dramatic views of the Brooklyn Bridge. Bohemian, opulent, and glamorous, it brings Gitano's signature tropical rustic elegance to the City with modern Mexican cuisine, signature mezcal cocktails, and an indoor-outdoor jungle experience.

name: Burrito Bar
summary: This Mexican restaurant is located in a converted house, with a bar on the first floor and restaurant seating on the second level.
summary2: The Burrito Bar, a Mexican restaurant founded in 1995 by Kim Beckett, is located in a converted house in West Brighton, Staten Island, with a bar on the first floor and restaurant seating on the second level. They serve modern Mexican cuisine and cocktails with an emphasis on quality, atmosphere and neighborhood. They offer dine-in and takeout, with many weekly specials and to-go deals. Burrito Bar also has an amazing outdoor patio. They accept walk-ins, reservations, and are available on most delivery sites.

name: Cathédrale
summary: Under soaring ceilings and a monumental wire-mesh sculpture by Edoardo Tresoldi, executive chef Jason Hall delivers pure, ingredient-driven flavors.
address: 112 East 11th Street, New York, New York 10003, United States
summary2: With a carefully curated menu, chef Jason Hall adds his own unique twist on classic French-Mediterranean cuisine that paints a picture of the coastal cuisine of Southern France, with brushstrokes of Italy, Spain and Greece, in a staggering setting. Watch the chefs bring your meal to life in an open-hearth kitchen, while you sip on a cocktail amongst good company.

name: Maison Passerelle
summary: Three-time James Beard Award winner Gregory Gourdet crafts a culinary language that links New York and France through the rich flavors of the French Caribbean, French Africa, and French Asia.
address: 1 Wall Street, New York, New York 10005, United States
summary2: At Maison Passerelle, three-time James Beard Award winner Gregory Gourdet crafts a culinary language all his own, one that links New York and France through the rich flavors of the French Caribbean, French Africa, and French Asia. Located within One Wall Street, the restaurant is a visual feast of custom frescoes, stained glass.. The menu features a prix fixe and tasting menu, all entirely gluten- and dairy-free, celebrating bold, globally inspired flavors with inclusivity at its core. Standouts include Strawberry Grouper with Pepper Confit, Cane Syrup-Glazed Duck with a West African-inspired tamarind jus, and Dry-Aged NY Strip Steak, rubbed in a Haitian coffee, chili, and spice mix. Rounding out the experience are showstopping desserts by executive pastry chef Rachel Green, a compelling wine list, and a rousing lineup of spirited and zero-proof cocktails all by beverage director Ren Neuman.

name: Casa Louie
summary: The menu at Hudson Yards' Casa Louie features their homemade pastas and pizzas (including gluten-free pastas and pizza), as well as some traditional Italian dishes.
address: 455 West 37th Street, New York, New York 10018, United States
summary2: Casa Louie—a newer addition to the Hudson Yards area (at the corner of 37th St. and Tenth Ave.)—has quickly become a neighborhood hotspot and go-to restaurant for both locals and visitors. The menu features their homemade pastas and pizzas (including gluten-free pastas and pizza), as well as some traditional Italian dishes. Menu highlights include some unique pizzas, such as pepperoni and jalapeño pizza topped with honey, as well as their most popular Sicilian Square Hot Louie pizza, layered with vodka sauce, house-made mozzarella, and pepperoni, topped off with hot honey, and baked in a pan with a cheese crust. And don't forget to try the tiramisu or soft-serve vanilla gelato made to order.

name: Bar Chuzo
summary: Bar Chuzo is a Latin bistro and cocktail bar in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, that specializes in coastal Ecuadorian staples, such as ceviche, chuzos (skewers) as well as paella, oysters and steak.
address: 9324 3rd Avenue, New York, New York 10029, United States
summary2: Bar Chuzo is a Latin bistro and cocktail bar in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, that specializes in coastal Ecuadorian staples, such as ceviche, chuzos (skewers) as well as paella, oysters and steak. In December 2025, Bar Chuzo won the Readers' Choice award for "Best Restaurant" from Brooklyn Magazine (bkmag.com).

name: Bleu Fin
summary: Bleu Fin Bar & Grill, a trendy seafood eatery in Crown Heights, Brooklyn, infuses the freshest ingredients with bold and tropical flavors of the Caribbean.
address: 1487 Broadway, Brooklyn, New York 11221, United States
summary2: Bleu Fin Bar & Grill is a trendy seafood eatery in Bushwick, Brooklyn. They infuse the freshest ingredients with bold and tropical flavors of the Caribbean.

name: Izakaya Futago
summary: Discover playful innovations like Spoon Sushi, a one-bite reimagining of traditional nigiri sushi, alongside freshly-made soba noodles, izakaya dishes, and original cocktails crafted with sake.
address: 211 East 43rd Street, New York, New York 10016, United States
summary2: At Izakaya Futago in East Midtown Manhattan, New Yorkers can discover playful innovations like Spoon Sushi: a one-bite reimagining of traditional nigiri sushi. Each skewer is carefully prepared and grilled to perfection. Enjoy the savory aroma and juicy flavor, along with the live cooking experience at the counter. The menu also features handcrafted, freshly-made soba noodles (Ni-Hachi buckwheat noodles) together with an extensive selection of izakaya dishes. Enjoy original cocktails crafted with sake, richly flavored Japanese whisky, and authentic Japanese bar food prepared by their skilled Japanese chef—whether it’s a romantic date, a gathering with friends, a quiet moment alone, or a drink with colleagues after work, guests will feel at home at the bar.

name: Sojourn Social
summary: Sojourn Social features a multifaceted venue paired with food and libations representing the melting pot of cultures and cuisines.
address: 1708 2nd Avenue, New York, New York 10128, United States
summary2: At Sojourn Social, it all starts with a great cocktail. Inspired by New York City's energetic and lively restaurant scene, they feature a multifaceted venue paired with food and libations representing the melting pot of cultures and cuisines.

name: The Splendid
summary: The Splendid Sporting Club is where elevated food, cocktails and sports meet informal elegance just steps from St. Patrick's Cathedral, Rockefeller Center and Radio City Music Hall in Midtown Manhattan.
address: 16 East 52nd Street, New York, New York 10022, United States
summary2: The Splendid Sporting Club is where elevated food, cocktails and sports meet informal elegance just steps from St. Patrick's Cathedral, Rockefeller Center and Radio City Music Hall in Midtown Manhattan. With chef Joey Fortunato (of West Village favorite Extra Virgin) at the helm, The Splendid is ready to be a new go-to for a business lunch, a refreshing cocktail after work or when taking a break from shopping on Fifth Avenue. You don't have to miss that big game, tournament or match in order to appreciate a fine meal.

name: Pico De Gallo Bar & Kitchen
summary: Pico De Gallo Bar & Kitchen blends traditional Mexican cuisine with the personal touch of executive chef Edgar Gomez, who brings more than 20 years of culinary experience.
address: 768 Amsterdam Avenue, New York, New York 10025, United States
summary2: At Pico De Gallo Bar & Kitchen, they take pride in blending traditional Mexican cuisine with the personal touch of executive chef Edgar Gomez, who brings more than 20 years of culinary experience. The dishes showcase the highest quality of raw and fresh ingredients. They are committed to providing guests with a first-class dining experience in a relaxing and inviting atmosphere, at an affordable cost. Pico De Gallo Bar & Kitchen offers an immersive atmosphere inspired by Mexican pop art, creating a space where every guest feels welcomed and celebrated.

name: Caravaggio
summary: Located on Manhattan's Upper East Side, Caravaggio boasts elegant Italian cuisine with a modern twist.
address: 23 East 74th Street, New York, New York 10021, United States
summary2: Located on Manhattan's Upper East Side, Caravaggio boasts elegant Italian cuisine with a modern twist. Its sophisticated cooking, flawless service and exquisite modern setting places it among the top restaurants in the City. Giuseppe Bruno—part of the family behind Italian eatery Sistina—launched this latest venture to carry on the family’s tradition of serving great food to devoted patrons.

name: El Bistró Tropical
summary: Colombian chef Juan Manuel Barrientos's restaurant offers a contemporary take on Latin American cuisine with a tropical flair, blending fresh, seasonal ingredients with French techniques and Colombian culinary traditions.
address: 1227 Broadway, New York, New York 10001, United States
summary2: El Bistró Tropical New York is a vibrant and sophisticated dining destination located inside the iconic Virgin Hotels Manhattan in the NoMad neighborhood of Manhattan. Created by renowned Colombian chef Juan Manuel Barrientos, the restaurant offers a contemporary take on Latin American cuisine with a tropical flair, blending fresh, seasonal ingredients with French techniques and Colombian culinary traditions. The menu features an inspired à la carte selection that includes expertly grilled meats, fresh seafood, handmade pastas, and signature desserts, all served in an elegant yet welcoming atmosphere. El Bistró Tropical captures the dynamic energy of NYC while delivering a bold, innovative, and festive dining experience that reflects Chef Barrientos' distinctive culinary vision.

name: Quality Italian
summary: Quality Italian has that wow factor—an unexpectedly beautiful, sexy dining space and lounge convenient to Carnegie Hall, Central Park, Fifth Avenue shopping and high-end hotels.
address: 57 West 57th Street, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Quality Italian has that wow factor—an unexpectedly beautiful, sexy dining space and lounge convenient to Carnegie Hall, Central Park, Fifth Avenue shopping and high-end hotels. A breezy bar is at street level, but the magic is found up a marble staircase, with secret nooks, sparkling cocktails and perhaps the most gorgeous bathrooms in the City. Like its sister restaurant, Quality Meats, there's a focus on steaks and chops. The raw bar, terrific salads and pastas are also noteworthy, but the dish generating the most buzz is the massive chicken parmigiana for two, cut into eight slices with a pizza wheel.

name: Crazy Pizza
summary: With its theatrical spirit and distinctive style, Crazy Pizza New York City fits seamlessly into their SoHo setting, offering a dining experience that blends local culture with deep Italian roots.
address: 218 Lafayette Street, New York, New York 10012, United States
summary2: Every street in SoHo tells a story. Here, Crazy Pizza brings Italian elegance into the energy of New York. After exploring SoHo’s art galleries, boutiques, and historic architecture, a stop at Crazy Pizza is a must: here, tradition meets creativity and boldness, giving life to a truly unique experience—just like their iconic pizza. With its theatrical spirit and distinctive style, Crazy Pizza New York City fits seamlessly into this urban setting, offering a dining experience that blends local culture with deep Italian roots. At this crossroads of tradition and innovation, they proudly serve extraordinary pizza, crafted with authentic flavors and a refined culinary vision.

name: Aquarelle
summary: Discover a captivating underwater world where the culinary approach mirrors the environment: beautiful presentation, bold flavors, and the freshest seafood prepared with precision and care.
address: 47 Avenue B, New York, New York 10009, United States
summary2: Step into Aquarelle and discover a captivating underwater world in Manhattan's East Village. The space transforms dining into an immersive journey with hand-crafted murals, dramatic lighting, and thoughtfully designed spaces that transport guests beneath the waves. Each area offers a distinctive atmosphere, from the intimate blue velvet banquettes beneath glowing sea-inspired lanterns to the striking wooden-paneled private dining room reminiscent of a luxury yacht. The culinary approach mirrors the environment: beautiful presentation, bold flavors, and the freshest seafood prepared with precision and care. Aquarelle's commitment to ocean conservation guides every decision they make. They partner exclusively with small-scale, responsible fisheries that share a dedication to sustainable harvesting methods and ecosystem preservation. Each morning, they carefully select seafood that meets the highest standards for both quality and environmental stewardship. Their Friend of the Sea certification reflects Aquarelle's pledge to protect marine habitats while still serving exceptional seafood.

summary: 8282 is a light-hearted, fresh take on Korean food on the Lower East Side.
address: 84 Stanton Street, New York, New York 10002, United States
summary2: 8282 is a light-hearted, fresh take on Korean food on the Lower East Side. The name 8282 refers to Korea’s country code, +82, and has an additional meaning: The numbers, when read together, translate to a phrase that means “quickly” or “faster.” The phrase signifies a get-it-done attitude. Behind 8282 is a couple who previously ran the restaurant Pado in the East Village. Bong Le Jo had cooked in the kitchens of Perry St, Dovetail and Kissaki, and Jee Kim launched several fashion and lifestyle brands, and worked as a truffle distributor in Seoul.

name: Pepolino
summary: Pepolino serves authentic Tuscan cuisine in TriBeCa.
address: 281 West Broadway, New York, New York 10013, United States
summary2: Pepolino is a casual yet elegant restaurant that serves authentic delicious Tuscan cuisine in the TriBeCa neighborhood of Manhattan. Daily specialties are complimented by red and white wine selections from around the world.‍

name: Dhamaka
summary: Located at Essex Market on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, Dhamaka dives deep into the bold, provincial cooking rarely seen outside of Indian homes and roadside stalls.
summary2: Dhamaka is an Unapologetic Foods restaurant celebrating the forgotten side of India. Located at Essex Market on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, Dhamaka dives deep into the bold, provincial cooking rarely seen outside of Indian homes and roadside stalls. The menu pays tribute to regional dishes that are often overlooked—intensely spiced, unfiltered, and rooted in memory.

name: Boni & Mott
summary: Boni & Mott brings the vibrant spirit of the Mediterranean to the NoLIta neighborhood of Manhattan, crafting fresh, flavorful dishes and curated wines in a warm, inviting space.
address: 238 Mott Street, New York, New York 10012, United States
summary2: Boni & Mott brings the vibrant spirit of the Mediterranean to the NoLIta neighborhood of Manhattan, crafting fresh, flavorful dishes and curated wines in a warm, inviting space where every meal feels like a celebration. Their passion is to create unforgettable moments through authentic cuisine, thoughtful service, and a cozy atmosphere that makes guests feel right at home.

name: Amélie - Upper West Side
summary: "La Petite Amélie" is smaller and more intimate than Amélie's other locations, but has the same look and vibe.
address: 566 Amsterdam Avenue, New York, New York 10024, United States
summary2: Amélie Upper West Side is a newer location that the owners like to call "La Petite Amélie." It is smaller and more intimate than their other locations, but has the same look and vibe. Amélie has won Michelin recognition in the Bib Gourmand category, and the extensive selection of wine will take you all around the world with the most generous pour. Happy Hour is served every day, and their popular wine tasting flights are available all night. The French staff is welcoming, friendly and knowledgeable.

name: Cha Cha Tang
summary: This Chinese restaurant offers a playful rendition of a classic “cha chaan teng” (a Hong Kong-style cafe or diner) with a downtown fine-dining ambiance.
address: 257 Sixth Avenue, New York, New York 10014, United States
summary2: Cha Cha Tang is a Chinese restaurant by Wilson Tang and John McDonald. The kitchen, led by executive chef Doron Wong, offers a playful rendition of a classic “cha chaan teng” (a Hong Kong-style cafe or diner) with a downtown fine-dining ambiance. The menu features a variety of dim sum, noodles and rice, along with chef specialities.  They offer Cantonese Roasted Duck on Friday, Saturday and Sunday, or upon request. The beverage team has curated an extensive wine list along with a collection of Asian Whiskey.  Weather permitting, Cha Cha Tang offers al fresco patio dining.

name: Poppy
summary: Poppy is a love letter to the East Village—where creativity meets comfort and every dish tells a story.
address: 505 East 12th Street, New York, New York 10009, United States
summary2: Poppy is a love letter to the East Village—where creativity meets comfort and every dish tells a story. They belinieve food should feel like a celebration. Their menu blends locally-inspired ingredients, creating plates that are both familiar and unexpected. Behind the bar, cocktails are as vibrant as the crowd. Settle into a plush booth, grab a seat at the bar, or dine under the City lights on the front patio—however you join them, the team at Poppy are there to make it memorable.

name: American Brass
summary: Located across from the historically preserved Long Island City Gantries on the East River waterfront, American Brass is a New American restaurant with a relaxed, upscale setting and a local focus.
address: 2-01 50th Avenue, Long Island City, New York 11101, United States
summary2: Located directly across from the historically preserved Long Island City Gantries on the East River waterfront, American Brass is a New American restaurant with a relaxed, upscale setting and a local focus. Chef Kevin McGinley, formerly of Michelin-starred restaurant Bátard, serves every dish with fanatical attention to flavor and detail. American Brass looks to the future with their sustainable practices. Long Island City's many excellent breweries are featured exclusively on the beer list. New York farms play a dominant role in sourcing their proteins and filling the pantry.

name: Saggio
summary: This Washington Heights restaurant offers fresh and simple Southern Italian cooking, with handmade pastas and savory sauces.
address: 827 West 181st Street, New York, New York 10033, United States
summary2: Located in Washington Heights, Saggio offers fresh and simple Southern Italian cooking, with handmade pastas and savory sauces. Rustic and relaxed with a top-notch wine and beer list, their goal is to cater to all. Each meal is made with the freshest, quality ingredients. Enjoy favorites like calamari, fresh salmon and their famous rigatoni, Grandma's recipe of slow cooked ragu with homemade meatballs and Italian sausage. Save room for dessert—the ricotta cheesecake drizzled in chocolate, with fresh strawberries and whipped cream on the side, is a real crowd-pleaser.

name: City Vineyard
summary: Offering year-round riverfront dining, live music, extraordinary views, and an elevated culinary experience, City Vineyard is the culinary outpost by City Winery.
summary2: Offering year-round riverfront dining, live music, extraordinary views and an elevated culinary experience, City Vineyard is the culinary outpost of City Winery. Restaurant and rooftop guests will enjoy unobstructed views of One World Trade and the Tribeca skyline on one side and sunsets over the Hudson River on the other. To complement the riverfront dining experience, City Vineyard offers a seasonal menu that spotlights fresh seafood, New American fare and award-winning, locally-crafted wines served from an eco-friendly tap system.

name: Anassa Taverna - Downtown
summary: Nestled in Battery Park City, Anassa is an elegant interpretation of the traditional Greek taverna.
address: 104 North End Avenue, New York, New York 10282, United States
summary2: Anassa is an elegant interpretation of the traditional Greek taverna. Nestled in Battery Park City, Anassa transports diners through a true culinary and cultural journey through the cobblestone roads of the ancient historical neighborhood of Plaka, featuring simply prepared fresh fish and traditional Greek fare. Within you will find breathtaking decor: a marble-covered bar, light wood furniture and floors, and walls adorned with framed Greek-themed posters and portraits.

name: Markette
summary: Markette is a modern European restaurant with Caribbean influences from chef India Doris (previously executive sous chef at two Michelin-starred Saga) and managing partner Alex Pfaffenbach.
address: 326 Seventh Avenue, New York, New York 10001, United States
summary2: Markette is a modern European restaurant with Caribbean influences from chef India Doris (previously executive sous chef at two Michelin-starred Saga) and managing partner Alex Pfaffenbach (Eleven Madison Park alum and former director of development for Quality Branded—Zou Zou's, Bad Roman and more). The seasonal menu draws inspiration from India's upbringing in London, where British staples were reimagined in a Caribbean household—boldly spiced and full of flavor. It also reflects her culinary journey across Europe, from working in a Normandy brasserie and small local restaurants in Spain to acclaimed London institutions such as La Trompette and Bibendum at the historic Michelin House. The beverage program is helmed by Chris Figueroa (previously of Saga, Crown Shy, and World's 50 Best-recognized Overstory).

name: Le Monde
summary: This restaurant in Columbia University’s neighborhood celebrates the cuisine of France's Loire Valley.
address: 2885 Broadway, New York, New York 10025, United States
summary2: This restaurant in Columbia University’s neighborhood celebrates the cuisine of the Loire Valley, a region known as the "Garden of France." Enjoy coq au vin or a potato, goat cheese and caramelized onion tart as you sample great Loire wines. Join students, residents and visitors alike in celebrating a convivial lifestyle—embrace the warm atmosphere, welcoming service and delicious food at breakfast, lunch, weekend brunch or dinner.

name: Fresco by Scotto
summary: For more than three decades, Fresco by Scotto, a family-run venture, has been a go-to destination for celebrities, CEOs, and New Yorkers in the know.
address: 34 East 52nd Street, New York, New York 10022, United States
summary2: Fresco by Scotto opened its doors as a family-run venture and quickly became a go-to destination for celebrities, CEOs, and New Yorkers in the know. More than three decades later, the restaurant continues to evolve while staying true to its roots: offering exceptional food, warm service, and a dining experience that feels like coming home (with better lighting and wine). Fresco by Scotto is proudly owned and operated by Rosanna Scotto of Fox 5's Good Day New York and her children, Jenna and LJ Ruggiero. From lunch meetings to special event nights and everything in between, Fresco remains a staple of Midtown dining—timeless, lively, and always delicious.

name: Jasmine's Caribbean Cuisine
summary: Set on Restaurant Row in the Theatre District, Jasmine's specializes in dishes from the Caribbean islands.
address: 371 West 46th Street, New York, New York 10036, United States
summary2: Set on Restaurant Row in the Theatre District, Jasmine's specializes in dishes from the Caribbean islands. Choose from favorites such as oxtail, jerk wings, empanadas, coconut salmon and much more. There are vegan options as well, plus a number of tropical drinks.

name: Mito - Fort Greene
summary: Mito's esteemed head chef, who has devoted numerous years to the masterful art of cooking, brings with him a wealth of experience at esteemed establishments such as Jean Georges and Buddha Bar.
address: 280 Ashland Place, Brooklyn, New York 11217, United States
summary2: The definition of modern Japanese cuisine is innovation. It refers to a new and imaginative approach to cooking and presentation of food, it pushes the boundaries of traditional culinary techniques, and it incorporates unexpected ingredients and flavors to create unique and unforgettable dining experiences. Mito's esteemed head chef, who has devoted numerous years to the masterful art of cooking, brings with him a wealth of experience at esteemed establishments such as Jean Georges and Buddha Bar. With his addition to their team, the owners anticipate elevating Mito to unprecedented heights.

name: Docks Off 5th
summary: This seafood-centric restaurant, steps away from Radio City Music Hall and Rockefeller Center, offers an unforgettable dining experience with Insta-worthy dishes, drinks and décor.
address: 25 West 51st Street, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Docks Off 5th is a seafood-centric restaurant that is steps away from Radio City Music Hall and Rockefeller Center. Guests can expect an unforgettable dining experience with Instagram-worthy dishes, drinks and décor—as Docks says, "the camera eats first." Try starters like Tuna Won-Tacos (ahi tuna, mango pico, avocado-lime crema) or Lava Shrimp (with creamy spicy volcano sauce). Follow up with an entrée such as Seafood Paradise (jerk salmon and shrimp, knuckle and claw lobster, peppers and onions, pineapple fried rice, open-faced pineapple), Crab Cake Stuffed Salmon (with lemon cream sauce), Filet Oscar (topped with jumbo lump crab meat and hollandaise) or Truffle Filet Frites (8 oz filet mignon, topped with truffle butter, served with shoestring fries or truffle parm fries). Desserts include Pina Colada Crème Brûlée and Fried Oreo Sundae.

name: La Tête d’Or
summary: La Tête d’Or is chef Daniel Boulud's New York steakhouse, which brings together the essence of American tradition with a refined French flair.
address: 318 Park Avenue South, New York, New York 10010, United States
summary2: La Tête d’Or is a New York steakhouse bringing together the essence of American tradition with a refined French flair. The first steakhouse of renowned chef Daniel Boulud, it features a richly enticing menu that offers all the indulgence of steakhouse favorites, elevated by the most premium cuts of meat and seafood offerings, plus the chef's specialty: perfectly flavorful sauces.  Designed by David Rockwell, the restaurant's grand yet welcoming decor features soaring ceilings, deep blue banquettes, and warm wood and copper accents. This thoughtfully crafted ambiance provides a perfect backdrop for celebrating timeless elegance and chef Boulud's culinary artistry.

name: A Pasta Bar
summary: At A Pasta Bar, an elegant Italian culinary theater in SoHo, the open-kitchen concept immerses guests in the energy of the craft, where skilled chefs prepare authentic Italian classics in full view.
address: 330 West Broadway, New York, New York 10013, United States
summary2: A Pasta Bar is an elegant Italian culinary theater in the SoHo neighborhood of Manhattan. Their open-kitchen concept immerses guests in the energy of the craft, where skilled chefs prepare authentic Italian classics in full view. Blending tradition with a modern sensibility, A Pasta Bar offers a refined yet lively dining experience that celebrates the art of fresh pasta, quality ingredients, and genuine Italian hospitality.

name: Barlume
summary: Barlume is an all-day dining experience steeped in the sun-soaked flavors of the Mediterranean.
address: 900 Broadway, New York, New York 10003, United States
summary2: Barlume is an all-day dining experience steeped in the sun-soaked flavors of the Mediterranean. With a menu designed to celebrate bright, fresh cuisine and a beverage program that marries creativity with nostalgia, Barlume promises a culinary journey that delights from morning to midnight and every moment in between.

name: Mokyo
summary: Mokyo offers an array of Asian-inspired cuisine that blend flavors from chef Kyungmin "Kay" Hyun's childhood and travels across Spain and South America.
address: 109 Saint Marks Place, New York, New York 10009, United States
summary2: Mokyo is a cozy nook in the East Village. The name is a playful way of saying "Thursday" in Korean ("mok" is the abbreviation "Thurs."), and Mokyo is the sister restaurant to Thursday Kitchen from chef Kyungmin "Kay" Hyun. Mokyo offers an array of Asian-inspired cuisine that blend flavors from Chef Kay’s childhood and travels across Spain and South America. Understanding the inevitable loss to her grandma and mom’s traditional dishes, Chef Kay has found a perfect balance of Asian twists and dishes from her travels to ignite nostalgic flavors yet something unfamiliar and pleasant with an Asian flair.

name: Quality Meats
summary: A property of the venerable Smith & Wollensky steakhouse overlords, this stylish restaurant is the domain of chef Craig Koketsu and the storied meats of purveyors Milton Abeles and Strassburger Meats.
address: 57 West 58th Street, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: A property of the venerable Smith & Wollensky steakhouse overlords, this stylish restaurant is the domain of chef Craig Koketsu and the storied meats of purveyors Milton Abeles and Strassburger Meats. And immediately you'll note what a difference the cut makes. The familiar-sounding menu is anything but—with a keenly focused eye on nouveau American cuisine, Koketsu creates fresh interpretations on everything from seared three filets to roasted chicken with pomegranate to roasted bone marrow. This is all in addition to a spectacular array of seafood.

name: La Pecora Bianca Upper West Side
summary: La Pecora Bianca Upper West Side offers an expanded menu from Mario Batali alum Cruz Goler in a bright, sophisticated space.
address: 359 Columbus Avenue, New York, New York 10024, United States
summary2: La Pecora Bianca Upper West Side offers an expanded menu from Mario Batali alum Cruz Goler in a bright, sophisticated space. Chef Goler takes Italian fare back to its roots as an inherently local and seasonal cuisine with a menu emphasizing vegetables and house-made pastas. In addition to classic La Pecora Bianca dishes such as gramigna with sausage and broccolini, the expanded menu features spuntini (small Italian snacks), shareable plates and a broad selection of fish and meat.

name: Benihana
summary: Benihana is a dining experience unlike any other: guests are seated at communal tables in groups, where a personal chef will perform the ancient art of teppanyaki.
address: 47 West 56th Street, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Benihana is a dining experience unlike any other: guests are seated at communal tables in groups, where a personal chef will perform the ancient art of teppanyaki. Watch as they slice and dice, preparing a meal of mouth-watering steak, tender chicken or succulent seafood that will dazzle the eyes as well as the taste buds. Also enjoy sushi prepared by a talented sushi chef, and indulge in a specialty cocktail. The restaurant includes a full bar with sushi lounge, great for after-work drinks and meeting friends. Celebrate a special occasion in the elegant private dining rooms.

name: Le Tout Va Bien
summary: The raison d’être of this cheery basement bistro is to get theater-going patrons fed and out the door by curtain time.
address: 311 West 51st Street, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Le Tout Va Bien serves traditional French food in a charming bistro ambiance and decor. The raison d’être of this cheery basement bistro is to get theater-going patrons fed and out the door by curtain time. Highlights include the  traditional onion soup, as well as escargot. Boeuf bourguignon is a winey charmer, sharing the spotlight with duck á l’orange and Dover sole meunière. Follow it up with crème brȗlée, crêpe Suzette or chocolate mousse.

name: PB Brasserie Steak House
summary: Harlem-bred and Senegalese-born chef and owner Elhadji Cisse, the force behind four popular restaurants in Harlem, has opened his biggest restaurant yet.
address: 60 West 125th Street, New York, New York 10027, United States
summary2: Harlem-bred and Senegalese-born chef and owner Elhadji Cisse, the force behind four popular restaurants, including Ponty Bistro, Harlem Cafe and Renaissance in Harlem, has opened his biggest restaurant yet. PB Brasserie is a sprawling 4,500-square-foot restaurant located on West 125th Street, steps from the Apollo Theater, in the epicenter of Harlem. This restaurant opening is the biggest the area has seen in years. PB Brasserie offers lunch, brunch and dinner to serve the community each and every day with a French flair.

name: Wan Waan
summary: The team at Wan Waan, a Thai restaurant in the Chelsea neighborhood of Manhattan, emphasizes feelings through the taste of food.
address: 200 8th Avenue, New York, New York 10011, United States
summary2: “Wan Waan” refers to days long ago that are remembered through memories and stories. Times past are recalled through various stimuli, familiar things such as listening to music, viewing old pictures, atmosphere, or even gaining familiar tastes. It helps people to reminisce about the days that have passed.  The team at Wan Waan, a Thai restaurant in the Chelsea neighborhood of Manhattan, emphasizes feelings through the taste of food. By stimulating positive emotions, the delicious tastes will bring guests nostalgic memories of the past and with it good memories. When diners make delicious memories together, then they will think of “Wan Waan” together.

name: Liman Restaurant
summary: Liman Restaurant is a Turkish-Mediterranean restaurant, specializing in seafood, and set in a nautically themed atmosphere on Surf Avenue in Coney Island, opposite the legendary Cyclone roller coaster.
address: Avenue, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Liman Restaurant is a Turkish-Mediterranean restaurant, specializing in seafood, and set in a nautically themed atmosphere on Surf Avenue in Coney Island, opposite the legendary Cyclone roller coaster. Liman features two terraces, and is an authentic taste of the Turkish Mediterranean coast.

name: Amaranth
summary: Enjoy the typical approach to Mediterranean flavor with a mix of French and Italian cuisine, with generous portions, based on fresh products and full of sunshine and flavors.
address: 21 East 62nd Street, New York, New York 10065, United States
summary2: At Amaranth, discover the best of Mediterranean cuisine just off Madison Avenue on Manhattan's Upper East Side.
