Enjoy fresh ingredients with flavors from around the world—his eclectic yet harmonious cuisine brings a dynamic perspective to classic techniques. Surfish also has a full bar serving excellent Pisco sours.

name: Stretch Pizza - Park Ave
summary: Stretch Pizza stays true to what pizza fans love about New York-style pies—the crunch and the chew of the crust, the classic red sauce, the cheese pull—but the menu stretches far beyond the standards.
address: 331 Park Avenue South, New York, New York 10010, United States
summary2: Stretch Pizza, from "New York City kids" Wylie Dufresne (WD-50) and Gadi Peleg (Breads Bakery), stays true to what pizza fans love about New York-style pies—the crunch and the chew of the crust, the classic red sauce, the cheese pull—but the menu stretches far beyond the standards. Stop by for Caesar salad and a classic pepperoni pie, or try some of the chef's new favorites, like his everything bagel pizza, or a mushroom-and-muenster one inspired by a sandwich from the Old Town Bar. On tap at the bar: beer, of course, but also Lambrusco and sparkling Negronis, along with a rotating list of craft cocktails. And there's always a fun flavor of soft serve for dessert.

name: Olio e Più Bryant Park
summary: Enjoy fresh, house-made pastas dressed with the highest quality ingredients and a hand-selected collection of excellent wines and cocktails to pair with your dish.
address: 1065 Sixth Avenue, New York, New York 10018, United States
summary2: Located just steps from Bryant Park, Olio e Più's second New York location offers a warm Italian escape in the Midtown West neighborhood of Manhattan. This authentic trattoria, which is surrounded by Fifth Avenue and Midtown charm, celebrates classic Italian cuisine made with seasonal ingredients and genuine hospitality. Whether stopping by after shopping, a park stroll, or work, guests are welcomed into a true taste of La Dolce Vita, where fine wine, timeless flavors, and good company come together.

name: SaiTong Thai
summary: SaiTong, an upscale Thai restaurant located in the Theatre District in Midtown Manhattan, offers an authentic modern Thai dining experience in an elegant, wood-accented atmosphere
address: 244 West 48th Street, New York, New York 10036, United States
summary2: SaiTong is an upscale Thai restaurant located in the Theatre District in Midtown Manhattan, just steps from Times Square. They offer an authentic modern Thai dining experience in an elegant, wood-accented atmosphere, perfect for a romantic night out or after a Broadway show. The restaurant blends the bold flavors of Thailand with a fresh, modern twist. They serve a wide range of contemporary Thai dishes that bring a creative flair to traditional ingredients, while also offering the classic favorites that everyone knows and loves. They also have Thai inspired cocktails and a cozy bar for guests who are just looking for a quick drink.

name: Le Basque
summary: Le Basque is an upscale vegan restaurant in Union Square that masterfully blends the rich culinary traditions of France and Spain into a unique, plant-based dining experience.
address: 15 Union Square West, New York, New York 10003, United States
summary2: Le Basque is an upscale vegan restaurant in Union Square that masterfully blends the rich culinary traditions of France and Spain into a unique, plant-based dining experience. As a dining destination that redefines modern vegan cuisine, Le Basque offers a carefully curated menu that celebrates the artistry of French and Spanish flavors, with a focus on fresh, seasonal ingredients. Each dish is thoughtfully crafted to honor the techniques and depth of flavor synonymous with these regions, all while showcasing the versatility and creativity of plant-based cooking. The name “Le Basque” pays homage to the Basque region, an area renowned for its vibrant and diverse cuisine that seamlessly marries the culinary heritage of both France and Spain. In keeping with this spirit, Le Basque brings together the bold, rustic flavors of Spanish tapas with the refined elegance of French gastronomy. The result is a harmonious fusion that delivers a one-of-a-kind dining experience, where innovative vegan dishes transport guests on a flavorful journey through the Basque country, highlighting the richness and complexity of these cuisines.

name: F&J Pine
summary: F&J Pine honors old world Italian roots, lifestyle, food, and décor.
address: Avenue, New York, New York 10039, United States
summary2: Over forty years since Francesco and Giovanni Bastone's original F&J Pine hosted droves of celebrities, Yankee players, New York notables and locals alike, guests find an old-school vibe with a modern edge. F&J Pine honors old world Italian roots, lifestyle, food, and décor. Designed to be an inviting, convivial restaurant and bar for locals and visitors alike, The Pine offers a relaxed and approachable atmosphere complemented by Francesco’s traditional Southern Italian food, which draws inspiration from his heritage to serve a menu of rustic Italian fare paired with an extensive menu of craft beers, cocktails and wine.

name: Smyth Tavern
summary: Smyth Tavern serves American tavern fare in Tribeca, featuring fresh fish, raw bar, dry-aged steaks, homemade pastas and a specialty burger.
address: 85 West Broadway, New York, New York 10007, United States
summary2: Smyth Tavern serves American tavern fare at the Smyth Tribeca hotel in Manhattan's Tribeca neighborhood, featuring fresh fish, raw bar, dry-aged steaks, homemade pastas and a specialty burger. The dining room is adorned with a rotating collection of artwork curated from local Downtown galleries.

name: Wabi Nori
summary: Wabi Nori offers an elevated interpretation of traditional Japanese cuisine on Manhattan's Lower East Side.
address: 115 Essex Street, New York, New York 10002, United States
summary2: Wabi Nori offers an elevated interpretation of traditional Japanese cuisine on Manhattan's Lower East Side. The warm, carefully curated space pairs authenticity with comfort, while high-quality ingredients and flawless execution define every dish and drink. Their unique menu features tapas-style Japanese plates, house-made desserts, and the freshest fish. A cozy, intimate atmosphere makes Wabi Nori perfect for date nights or gatherings with friends.

name: Amélie - West Village
summary: At this Greenwich Village location, the intention is to make good wine accessible, affordable and fun.
address: 22 West 8th Street, New York, New York 10011, United States
summary2: Amélie has become one of the most successful wine bars in the City, attracting an eclectic crowd nightly. At this Greenwich Village location, the intention is to make good wine accessible, affordable and fun. With its euro-chic décor, sensual lighting and great bar music, Amélie has changed the way good wine is enjoyed and consumed. Patrons appreciate the generous pour, the terrific French cuisine, the international flair, and the great choice of good wines at fair prices.

name: Naro
summary: Naro’s menu focuses on the subtle and delicate flavors of Korean cuisine, drawing inspiration from classic dishes from various moments throughout Korean history.
address: 610 5th Avenue, New York, New York 10020, United States
summary2: Naro, from the team behind Atoboy and Atomix, is located on the Rink Level in Rockefeller Center. Naro’s menu focuses on the subtle and delicate flavors of Korean cuisine, and is rooted in traditional ingredients and techniques, drawing inspiration from classic dishes from various moments throughout Korean history. Chef Junghyun "JP" Park is a Seoul-born, New York City-based chef, most recently recognized as "Best Chef: NY State (2023)" by the James Beard Foundation.

name: Barrio BX
summary: Barrio BX is a Puerto Rican restaurant in the Bronx dedicated to honoring the island’s cuisine, culture, and revolutionary spirit.
summary2: Barrio BX is a Puerto Rican restaurant in the Bronx dedicated to honoring the island’s cuisine, culture, and revolutionary spirit. Guests often describe it as a home away from home, praising the food, music, and hospitality for capturing the heart of Puerto Rican tradition with Bronx soul and serving as a true reflection of the Nuyorican experience. The space doubles as a living gallery, filled with murals and artifacts that celebrate Puerto Rican resistance, pride, and community, both on the walls and through live events. With over 24,000 followers on Instagram and a loyal local following, Barrio BX is a cultural touchstone built by and for the people it represents. The weekly event lineup is posted every Monday on Instagram. Seating is first come, first served.

name: Mama Mezze
summary: Mama Mezze is an all-day, wood-fired restaurant offering bright, comforting dishes from around the Eastern Mediterranean Sea.
address: 1123 Broadway, New York, New York 10010, United States
summary2: Mama Mezze is an all-day, wood-fired restaurant offering bright, comforting dishes from around the Eastern Mediterranean Sea. They offer an array of spreads with house-made za’atar bread, wood-fired skewers and sandwiches, shareable small and large plates, and more. Mama Mezze features a sunlit dining room with an oversized citrus tree and vibrant greenery, two outdoor patios with more than 100 seats, and a permanent floral installation.

name: Ishq
summary: The menu at this East Village restaurant is a celebration of India's culinary treasures—from aromatic curries to flavorful tandoori offerings, all made with the finest spices and ingredients.
address: 202 Avenue a, New York, New York 10009, United States
summary2: The menu at this East Village restaurant is a celebration of India's culinary treasures—from aromatic curries to flavorful tandoori offerings, all made with the finest spices and ingredients. But what truly sets Ishq apart is its dedication to storytelling through food. Every dish on the menu is a tribute to ancestors, rekindling the love for age-old recipes while adapting to the global palate of New York City diners. At Ishq, tradition meets innovation on every plate. The dishes are steeped in authenticity, drawing from the rich culinary heritage of India’s diverse regions. Each recipe has been meticulously crafted to preserve its original flavors, yet plated with an artistic flair that speaks to modern sensibilities.

name: Code Red Restaurant & Lounge
summary: Code Red Restaurant & Lounge is a dynamic and innovative Caribbean restaurant and bar located in the Laconia neighborhood in The Bronx.
summary2: Code Red Restaurant & Lounge is a dynamic and innovative Caribbean restaurant and bar located in the Laconia neighborhood in The Bronx. They serve brunch every Sunday, and present weekly "Seafood Wednesday" with crack 'n peel bags and several varieties of boils, including all-you-can-eat.

name: La Pecora Bianca Upper East Side
summary: La Pecora Bianca Upper East Side offers an expanded menu from Mario Batali alum Cruz Goler in a bright, sophisticated space.
address: 1562 2nd Avenue, New York, New York 10028, United States
summary2: La Pecora Bianca Upper East Side offers an expanded menu from Mario Batali alum Cruz Goler in a bright, sophisticated space. Chef Goler takes Italian fare back to its roots as an inherently local and seasonal cuisine with a menu emphasizing vegetables and house-made pastas. In addition to classic La Pecora Bianca dishes such as gramigna with sausage and broccolini, the expanded menu features spuntini (small Italian snacks), shareable plates and a broad selection of fish and meat.

name: Masalawala & Sons
summary: Restaurateur Roni Mazumdar and Chintan Pandya explore the yesteryears of India from the perspective of a 75-year-old immigrant man from Kolkata—Roni’s father.
address: 365 5th Avenue, New York, New York 10016, United States
summary2: Restaurateur Roni Mazumdar and Chintan Pandya explore the yesteryears of India from the perspective of a 75-year-old immigrant man from Kolkata—Roni’s father. His favorite memories of food have been recreated with utmost integrity, intricate age-old techniques, authentic cookware and family recipes. Those fleeting moments from the homes in Kolkata to the homes he visited are being restored at this festive space in the heart of Park Slope, Brooklyn

name: Romeo's Italian Restaurant
summary: Romeo's Italian Restaurant offers fine Italian dining in Jackson Heights, Queens.
address: 37th Avenue, Long Island City, New York 11101, United States
summary2: Please note that Saturdays are excluded and Sundays are optional. Be sure to check with the restaurant for hours of operation and scheduled closures.

name: ABC Kitchens DUMBO
summary: ABC Kitchens’ seasonally driven menu is an evolution and combination of Jean-Georges' Manhattan restaurants, ABC Kitchen, abcV and ABC Cocina, under one roof on the DUMBO waterfront.
address: 55 Water Street, Brooklyn, New York 11201, United States
summary2: Chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten has opened ABC Kitchens, his first-ever Brooklyn restaurant, located on the iconic DUMBO waterfront at Empire Stores. ABC Kitchens’ seasonally-driven menu is an evolution and combination of ABC Kitchen’s approach to greenmarket fare, abcV's innovative plant-based dishes and ABC Cocina's global flavors, under one roof. The industrial waterfront space features a commanding peninsula bar and a central glass enclosure that functions as a retail space, selling vintage glassware, tableware and florals, and transforms into a whimsical dinner scene by night. ABC Kitchens is also available for private dining, where guests can dine amongst vintage decor, antique chandeliers and abundant blooms.

name: Allora Fifth Ave
summary: Enjoy the robust and delicious collection of entrées—many of which are prepared tableside at this classic Italian-American restaurant and bar located in NoMad.
address: 292 5th Avenue, New York, New York 10001, United States
summary2: Allora Ristorante is a classic Italian-American restaurant and bar located in Manhattan's NoMad neighborhood. Enjoy the robust and delicious collection of entrées—many of which are prepared tableside, like the Bistecca di Manzo à la Diane or the flambéed desserts. Pair your meal with a refreshing cocktail or select a wine from the vast array of labels and vintages.

name: Leon’s
summary: Leon’s is a neighborhood Italian restaurant with French and Egyptian accents from Natalie Johnson and Nick Anderer (also of Anton’s in the West Village).
address: 817 Broadway, New York, New York 10003, United States
summary2: Leon’s is a neighborhood Italian restaurant with French and Egyptian accents from Natalie Johnson and Nick Anderer (also of Anton’s in the West Village). The restaurant is inspired by Natalie’s heritage (named after her great grandfather, Leon Hakim) and the couple's travels together across the Mediterranean. Leon’s spotlights Anderer’s deep passion for Italian cuisine, as well as his thoughtful interpretations of treasured Hakim family recipes and culinary traditions passed down by way of Egypt and France. The restaurant’s beverage program, helmed by Johnson, complements and enhances the culinary offerings, highlighting winemakers, brewers, and distillers the couple and their team admire. The restaurant’s lovely, transporting design evokes the quiet, weathered beauty of an Italian seaside town, celebrates natural light, and preserves key architectural details of the building (circa 1895), and the duo spent years hand-selecting the furniture, fixtures, and art that adorn the space.

name: Paris Bar
summary: Paris Bar is an iconic French brasserie near Carnegie Hall and Central Park that serves traditional French fare from breakfast through supper every day, with brunch available on weekends, plus a rooftop bar.
address: 120 West 57th Street, New York, New York 10019, United States
summary2: Paris Bar is an iconic French brasserie nestled within the Le Meridien hotel near Carnegie Hall and Central Park. They serve traditional French fare from breakfast through supper every day, with brunch available on weekends. Known for its lively ambiance, warm service, and soulful cuisine, the menu features fresh seafood and shellfish as well as signature French dishes such as Beef Bourguignon and bouillabaisse. For those seeking a breathtaking view to accompany their meal, there's Le Jardin Rooftop Bar, offering stunning views of Central Park. It's the perfect spot to unwind with a drink, enjoy a light bite, and take in the cityscape.

name: Don Cheech
summary: Don Cheech is an Italian-American restaurant created by executive chef Massimo Felici, inspired by his old neighborhood, Manhattan's old-school Little Italy.
summary2: Don Cheech is an Italian-American restaurant created by executive chef Massimo Felici, inspired by his old neighborhood, the old-school Little Italy (Mulberry Street in Manhattan), where exceptionally well-prepared food was served in an elegant comfortable setting. Traditional dishes like Stuffed Long Hots, Seafood Salad, Linguine Vongola, Chicken Parmigiana, Scarpariello, and Steak Diane are elevated to a new level. Tablecloth settings, burgundy booths, chandeliers and mirrors, a large bar, and a glass wine room gives Don Cheech that old-school elegant atmosphere.

name: Sistina
summary: Sistina has impressed its clientele for more than 40 years with inspired cuisine that is matched by an outstanding wine list, impeccable service and attractive decor.
address: 24 East 81st Street, New York, New York 10028, United States
summary2: Sistina, one of the highest-rated Italian restaurants in New York City, has impressed its clientele for more than 40 years. The restaurant’s inspired cuisine is matched by an outstanding wine list, impeccable service and attractive decor. As soon as guests enter, they are witness to Sistina's romantic ambience, candles and fresh flower arrangements. Cast-iron wall hangings show the whimsical side of the fratelli Bruno. But patrons keep returning for the brothers’ abilities to make simple dishes taste like creative masterpieces.

name: Hudson VU
summary: Hudson Local, in the Ink 48 Hotel in Hell’s Kitchen, presents chef Samuel-Drake Jones' menu of creative New American dishes, sommelier Lacey Rozinsky's curated wine list, and timeless cocktails.
address: 653 11th Avenue, New York, New York 10036, United States
summary2: Hudson Local, situated on the ground floor of Ink 48 Hotel in Hell’s Kitchen, presents an elegant yet approachable take on New York dining. Led by chef Samuel-Drake Jones, the menu highlights creative New American dishes and modern comforts, complemented by a carefully curated wine program from general manager and sommelier Lacey Rozinsky, as well as a selection of timeless cocktails. Guests can enjoy their experience in the welcoming dining room or settle into lounge-style nooks accented by a grand piano, adding to the restaurant’s distinctive character.

name: Korali Estiatorio
summary: Set in a serene, beautiful space with whitewashed arched walls and stonework reminiscent of Cretan Islands, this Upper East Sider focuses on Greek seafood.
address: 1662 3rd Avenue, New York, New York 10128, United States
summary2: Korali Estiatorio is a gem on Manhattan's Upper East Side, set in a serene, beautiful space with whitewashed arched walls and stonework reminiscent of Cretan Islands. They focus on Greek seafood, and bring to the table a passion for amazing ingredients and flavors. The menu offers decadent fare with offerings such as calamari, mussels, and grilled Mediterranean octopus, just to name a few. Share appetizers such as crab cakes, made fresh daily. Don't forget Korali's selection of delicious desserts.

name: Anassa Taverna - Astoria
summary: Set in Astoria, Queens, Anassa is an elegant interpretation of the traditional Greek taverna.
address: 28-10 Astoria Boulevard, Astoria, New York 11102, United States
summary2: Anassa is an elegant interpretation of the traditional Greek taverna. Set in Astoria, Queens, Anassa transports diners through a true culinary and cultural journey through the cobblestone roads of the ancient historical neighborhood of Plaka, featuring simply prepared fresh fish and traditional Greek fare. Within you will find breathtaking decor: high, airy ceilings, light wood furniture and floors, and walls adorned with framed Greek-themed posters and portraits.

name: Unglo Thai BBQ
summary: Discover Unglo’s signature dishes, premium meats, fresh vegetables, and bold Thai flavors grilled to perfection.
address: 35 West 64th Street, New York, New York 10023, United States
summary2: Unglo presents the art of Thai BBQ from the team behind Chalong and Soothr. It's a social, sizzling mix of grill and hot pot, premium proteins, and signature sauces on Manhattan's Upper West Side. Discover Unglo’s signature dishes, premium meats, fresh vegetables, and bold Thai flavors grilled to perfection.

name: Yefsi Estiatorio
summary: Yefsi Estiatorio, a Greek restaurant on Manhattan's Upper East Side, features an upscale selection of souvlaki, seafood, and Greek Mediterranean cuisine.
address: 1481 York Avenue, New York, New York 10075, United States
summary2: Yefsi Estiatorio, a Greek restaurant on Manhattan's Upper East Side, features an upscale selection of souvlaki, seafood, and Greek Mediterranean cuisine. When chef Katerina Efthymiadou creates the ever-changing menus and cooks the dishes, she's sitting at a table with her mother in their horio (village). The traditional recipes from western Greece use the freshest herbs, spices, and of course, lots of olive oil to bring out the flavor of Greece. Yefsi is open for lunch on weekdays, brunch on weekends, and dinner seven days a week.

name: Ponty Bistro
summary: West African, French and Mediterranean fusion cuisine is served with warm hospitality and exceptional service at Ponty Bistro.
address: 2375 Adam Clayton Powell Junior Boulevard, New York, New York 10030, United States
summary2: Two cousins who moved to the United States from Dakar, Senegal, in 1995 combine their Senegalese and West African cooking traditions with current culinary practices to create enticing dishes that reflect the flavors of their heritage—with a modern twist. Their West African, French and Mediterranean fusion cuisine is served with warm hospitality and exceptional service at Ponty Bistro. The menu includes Poisson Braise a le Guet Ndar, Niokolokoba and Kashbah Lamb Shank with Merquez, along with steaks, fresh seafood, poultry, salads and vegetarian dishes, plus an assortment of unexpected home-style comfort foods.

name: Catch n' Chop
summary: Catch n' Chop, situated on the Upper East Side, is a chef-driven modern American steakhouse with a focus on sustainable, fresh seafood and raw bar.
address: 1600 3rd Avenue, New York, New York 10128, United States
summary2: Catch n' Chop, situated on the Upper East Side, is a chef-driven modern American steakhouse with a focus on sustainable, fresh seafood and raw bar. Catch n' Chop exudes warmth and welcomes guests with open arms. With its cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, and a menu bursting with mouthwatering dishes, it's the perfect place to unwind and savor a delightful meal. The diverse menu caters to every palate, whether you're looking for a leisurely dinner with loved ones, a quick catch-up with friends, or a solo meal at the bar. Catch n' Chop offers a relaxed setting where laughter flows as freely as the conversation. Come as you are, and leave with a satisfied heart, a full stomach, and a smile.
